description: The chart illustrates ColEG-R performance (in percent) for three LLaMA-2 model sizes under four SFT (supervised fine-tuning) conditions. The horizontal axis lists the model categories LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B from left to right, and the vertical axis is labeled “ColEG-R (%)” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to about 90 with regularly spaced tick marks every 10 units. For each model category, four adjacent bars are shown as a grouped set: a light blue bar with diagonal hatch labeled “no SFT” at approximately 66–67% for 7B, ~70% for 13B, and ~81% for 70B; a light orange bar with horizontal hatch labeled “+ SFT on D₀” at approximately ~66–67% for 7B, ~74% for 13B, and ~82% for 70B; a light purple bar with diagonal hatch labeled “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” at approximately ~81% for 7B, ~85% for 13B, and ~85% for 70B; and a solid light pink bar labeled “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” at approximately ~84% for 7B, ~80% for 13B, and ~84% for 70B. The bars are not presented as stacked, and there is no explicit sorting by value beyond the fixed left-to-right ordering of model sizes; no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the distinct colors and hatch patterns indicated in the legend.
